title: Session Log 2026-05-04 Opus Summary

canonical_node.axiom: A session handoff must be machine-ingestible and human-readable, preserving decisions, results, and open threads without loss.
definitions: Machine layer: structured manifest with tables, counts, and explicit decisions.
Human layer: readable summary with context and next steps.
Handoff: a document that allows another AI or human to continue work without raw chat history.
derivation: The dropped page contained a full session recap.
It was split into a machine-ingest manifest and a startup summary.
The manifest captures canonical inputs, decisions, results, and open threads.
The summary provides a readable narrative for immediate use.
canonical_node.action: When a session handoff is dropped, parse it into a structured manifest and a readable summary, preserving all decisions, results, and open threads.
boundary: Does not guarantee the underlying data is correct or complete.
Does not validate the scientific claims or statistical results.
Does not replace the original session log if it contains additional context.
test: Check that all decisions listed in the source appear in the manifest.
Check that all open threads are listed.
Check that the summary is readable by another AI without raw chat history.

dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides a structured handoff format that can be ingested by another AI, enabling continuity without raw chat history.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the decisions, results, and open threads from the original session.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: Without this handoff, the next session would need to re-read the raw chat history or lose context.

overstatement_risks: The statistical results are presented as findings but are not independently verified.
The handoff format is described as correct but may not be robust to freeform inputs.
kill_conditions: If the source session log is missing or corrupted.
If the handoff format is not followed by downstream systems.
risk.lean_target: A minimal handoff template that captures decisions, results, and open threads.

plain_summary: This document describes a workflow for converting a session log into a structured handoff. It lists decisions, results, and open threads from a specific session, but does not provide formal proof of any scientific claims.
